map.输入成对(x,y)样本数据，用最小二乘法拟合直线y=ax+b，输出斜率a、截距b: Enter paired (x, y) data and fit a line y = ax + b by least squares, returning the slope a, intercept b, correlation coefficient, and goodness of fit, and allowing you to predict y for any x — for trend analysis and data modeling.
map.斜率 a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²)；截距: Slope a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²); intercept b = (Σy − aΣx) / n; prediction ŷ = a·x + b
map.用最小二乘法对 5 对 (x, y) 样本拟合直线 y = ax + b：斜率: Fit a line y = ax + b to 5 (x, y) pairs by least squares: the slope a is the covariance of x and y divided by the variance of x, and the intercept b makes the line pass through the sample means (x̄, ȳ). Substituting any x gives a prediction ŷ, for trend analysis and data modeling.
map.给定效应、样本量、α 求检验功效（1−β）。: Given the effect, sample size, and α, find the power of the test (1−β).
map.功效低易漏检真实效应。: Low power easily misses a real effect.
map.：α=0.05、n=30/组、d=0.5：功效≈0.48，偏低（易漏检）；增至: : with α=0.05, n=30 per group, and d=0.5, power ≈ 0.48, which is low and easy to miss an effect; raising to n=64 per group gives power ≈ 0.80, meeting the target.
map.效应越大功效越高: A larger effect gives higher power
map.：d=0.8、n=30：功效≈0.86，已足。: : with d=0.8 and n=30, power ≈ 0.86, which is sufficient.
map.由数值序列求样本标准差: Sample standard deviation from a data series
map.真实效应存在时正确拒绝原假设的概率（1−β）；通常要求 ≥0.8。: The probability of correctly rejecting the null when a real effect exists (1−β); ≥0.8 is usually required.
map.α、n、d、功效四者关系？: How Do α, n, d, and Power Relate?
map.给定三者可求第四者；设计时常固定 α 与目标功效，反推所需 n 或 detect: Given any three you can solve for the fourth; in design you usually fix α and the target power and back out the required n or the detectable d.
